learning_outcomes.text: The student will gain theoretical and practical knowledge of data modeling and database technologies, and can design and implement a program that uses persistence relational database data.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, motivation and basic concepts of database systems
Data modeling - conceptual level, E-R model
Relational model, transformation of conceptual model into schema in relational database
SQL language - DDL, DML, Relational algebra
Database connectors, O / R mapping, architectural patterns of data sources
assessment_rules: Students must prepare and submit all mandatory assignments and projects. A minimum of 20 points must be obtained from continuous tests (at least 6 points), project, and the final test. The final grade is calculated from continuous tests (15%), project (30%), and a final test (55%).
bibliography: Date, C: An Introduction to Database Systems, Pearson; 8th edition, 2004.
Garcia-Molina, H, Ullman J.D., Wisdom, J.: Database Systems: The Complete Book, Prentice-Hall, 2002
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
